cmd: uname -a && whoami && pwd && ls /app
ls -la /app/deps/ && cat /etc/os-release | head -3 && which gcc g++ make wget curl bzip2 gzip 2>&1
cat /app/deps/illum1.pov
apt-get update -qq 2>&1 | tail -2
head -40 /app/deps/illum1.pov
DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -qq gcc g++ make bzip2 xz-utils flex bison 2>&1 | tail -3
WAIT 45
curl -sL https://www.povray.org/download/ -o /tmp/dl.html; grep -oiE 'href="[^"]*"' /tmp/dl.html | grep -iE '2\.2|older|source|tar' | head -30
ls -la /tmp/dl.html; head -20 /tmp/dl.html; echo ---; grep -ci povray /tmp/dl.html
clear; curl -s "http://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=povray.org*&filter=original:.*2\.2.*&collapse=urlkey&limit=200&fl=original" 2>&1 | sort -u | head -60
WAIT 20
READ 60

clear; cd /tmp && curl -sL -A "Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64) AppleWebKit/537.36" "http://www.povray.org/?_gotefile=povray-2.2_src_all.tar.gz&download=1&raw=1" -o povray-2.2_src_all.tar.gz; ls -la povray-2.2_src_all.tar.gz; file povray-2.2_src_all.tar.gz

head -c 300 /tmp/povray-2.2_src_all.tar.gz; echo; curl -s "http://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=www.povray.org/%3F_gotefile%3Dpovray-2.2_src_all.tar.gz*&fl=timestamp,original,statuscode,length&limit=50" | head -30
clear; curl -s "http://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=povray.org&matchType=domain&filter=original:.*src_all.*&fl=timestamp,original,statuscode,length&collapse=urlkey&limit=40" | head -20
WAIT 30

clear; curl -s "http://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=www.povray.org&matchType=domain&filter=original:.*src_all.*&filter=length:>100000&fl=timestamp,original,statuscode,length&limit=40" | head -20

find / -maxdepth 4 \( -iname "*povray*" -o -iname "*pov*" \) -not -path "/proc/*" -not -path "/sys/*" -not -path "/app/deps/*" 2>/dev/null | head -30; ls -la /root /opt /srv /usr/src /var/cache 2>/dev/null | head -50
WAIT 40

clear; cd /tmp
curl -s "http://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=povray.org/download/source/2.2/POV-Ray-2.2-source.tar.gz&fl=timestamp,original,statuscode,length&limit=30" > cdx1.txt
curl -s "http://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=povray.org/ftp/pub/povray/Official-2.2/*&fl=timestamp,original,statuscode,length&collapse=urlkey&limit=60" > cdx2.txt
curl -s "http://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=povray.org/download/2.2.10/povray-2.2.10-src.tgz&fl=timestamp,original,statuscode,length&limit=30" > cdx3.txt
echo DONE
WAIT 60
wc -l cdx*.txt; echo ===cdx1===; cat cdx1.txt; echo ===cdx2===; cat cdx2.txt; echo ===cdx3===; cat cdx3.txt

cd /tmp; curl -s "http://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=povray.org/ftp/pub/povray/Official-2.2/pov_unix_220.tar&fl=timestamp,original,statuscode,length&limit=40" > cdx4.txt; curl -s "http://archive.org/advancedsearch.php?q=identifier%3A(povray)&fl%3Didentifier,title&rows=40&output=json" > ia.json; curl -s "https://sourceforge.net/projects/povray/files/" -o sf.html; echo ALLDONE; wc -c cdx4.txt ia.json sf.html
WAIT 30
echo ===cdx4===; cat cdx4.txt; echo ===ia===; cat ia.json; echo; echo ===sf===; cat sf.html

clear; cd /tmp; curl -s "http://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=povray.org/download/source/2.2/&matchType=prefix&fl=timestamp,original,statuscode,length&collapse=urlkey&limit=100" > cdx5.txt; curl -s "http://archive.org/advancedsearch.php?q=povray%20AND%20mediatype:software&fl=identifier,title&rows=40&output=json" > ia2.json; echo QDONE; cat cdx5.txt; echo ===IA===; python3 -c "import json;d=json.load(open('ia2.json'));[print(x) for x in d['response']['docs']]" 2>&1 | head -20
head -c 1000 ia2.json; echo; echo ===; grep -oE '"identifier":"[^"]*"' ia2.json | head -20

clear; cd /tmp; for f in povray-2.2.tar.gz povray-2.2-src.tar.gz povray-2.2-src.tgz povray-2.2.tar.bz2 povray-2.2_src_all.tar.gz povray-2.2-src-all.tar.gz povray-2.2.0.tar.gz povray-2.2-20050613.tar.gz povray-2.2.10.tar.gz POV-Ray-2.2.tar.gz; do code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{size_download}" "https://www.povray.org/download/source/2.2/$f"); echo "$code  $f"; done

clear; cd /tmp; curl -s "http://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=povray.org/download/2.2/&matchType=prefix&fl=timestamp,original,statuscode,length&collapse=urlkey&limit=200" > cdx6.txt; wc -l cdx6.txt; grep -E " 200 " cdx6.txt | head -30
cat cdx6.txt

clear; cd /tmp; curl -s "http://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=povray.org/download/&matchType=prefix&from=2024&fl=timestamp,original,statuscode,length&collapse=urlkey&limit=400" > cdx7.txt; wc -l cdx7.txt; grep -E " 200 " cdx7.txt | grep -vE " 200 (5[0-9]{3}|[0-9]{3}) " | head -40

clear; cd /tmp; curl -s "http://web.archive.org/web/20260617200010id_/https://www.povray.org/download/index.php/v2.2" -o v22page.html; wc -c v22page.html; grep -oiE '(href|src)="[^"]*"' v22page.html | head -40
cat v22page.html
clear; cd /tmp; zcat v22page.html 2>/dev/null || mv v22page.html v22.gz && (zcat v22.gz 2>/dev/null || gzip -dc v22.gz 2>/dev/null) | tee v22page.txt | head -80
clear; cd /tmp; curl -sL "http://www.povray.org/ftp/pub/povray/Old-Versions/" -o oldver.html; wc -c oldver.html; grep -oiE 'href="[^"]*"' oldver.html | head -50

head -c 200 oldver.html; echo; echo ===CDX===; curl -s "http://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=povray.org/ftp/pub/povray/Old-Versions/&matchType=prefix&fl=timestamp,original,statuscode,length&collapse=urlkey&limit=400" > cdx8.txt; wc -l cdx8.txt
clear; grep -iE "2\.2|22" cdx8.txt | head -40

clear; curl -s "http://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=povray.org/ftp/pub/povray/Old-Versions/2.2&matchType=prefix&fl=timestamp,original,statuscode,length&limit=100" > cdx10.txt; cat cdx10.txt | head -30; echo ===OFFICIAL===; curl -s "http://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=povray.org/ftp/pub/povray/Official-2.2&matchType=prefix&fl=timestamp,original,statuscode,length&limit=200" > cdx11.txt; cat cdx11.txt | head -50

clear; cd /tmp; curl -s "http://web.archive.org/web/20260830203102id_/https://www.povray.org/ftp/pub/povray/Official-2.2/Unix/povdoc22.tgz" -o t1.gz; wc -c t1.gz; head -c 300 t1.gz | od -c | head -5; echo ===DIRECT===; curl -s -o t2.gz -w "%{http_code} %{size_download}\n" "https://www.povray.org/ftp/pub/povray/Official-2.2/Unix/povdoc22.tgz"; wc -c t2.gz

clear; curl -s "http://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=povray.org/2.2&matchType=prefix&fl=timestamp,original,statuscode,length&collapse=urlkey&limit=100" > cdx12.txt; wc -l cdx12.txt; head -30 cdx12.txt; echo ===DOC===; curl -s "http://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=povray.org/documentation/view/2.2.2&matchType=prefix&fl=timestamp,original,statuscode,length&collapse=urlkey&limit=40" | head -20

clear; cd /tmp; timeout 120 curl -s "http://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=povray.org&matchType=domain&from=2004&to=2013&filter=original:.*2\.2.*&filter=statuscode:200&filter=length:>50000&fl=timestamp,original,statuscode,length&collapse=urlkey&limit=200" > cdx13.txt; wc -l cdx13.txt; cat cdx13.txt
WAIT 90

cd /tmp; timeout 180 curl -s "http://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=povray.org&matchType=domain&from=2004&to=2013&filter=original:.*2\.2.*&fl=timestamp,original,statuscode,length&collapse=urlkey&limit=500" > cdx14.txt; echo RC=$?; wc -l cdx14.txt; grep -iE "\.(tar|tgz|zip|Z)( |$)" cdx14.txt | grep " 200 " | head -40
clear; curl -s "https://archives.fedoraproject.org/pub/archive/fedora/linux/core/6/source/SRPMS/" -o fc6srpms.html; wc -c fc6srpms.html; grep -oiE 'href="[^"]*povray[^"]*"' fc6srpms.html | head

grep -ci povray fc6srpms.html; grep -oiE 'href="[^"]*\.src\.rpm"' fc6srpms.html | grep -iE "pov|render" | head; echo ===FC6EXTRAS===; curl -s "https://archives.fedoraproject.org/pub/archive/fedora/extras/6/source/SRPMS/" -o fc6x.html; wc -c fc6x.html; grep -oiE 'href="[^"]*povray[^"]*"' fc6x.html | head

clear; wc -l cdx14.txt 2>/dev/null; grep -iE "\.(tar|tgz|zip|Z)" cdx14.txt 2>/dev/null | grep " 200 " | head -30; echo ===FE===; curl -s "https://archives.fedoraproject.org/pub/archive/fedora/extras/" | grep -oiE 'href="[^"]*"' | head -20
clear; sort -u cdx14.txt | head -60
clear; curl -s -m 30 "http://ftp.povray.org/pub/povray/Old-Versions/" -o ftp1.html; echo "RC=$? size=$(wc -c < ftp1.html)"; head -c 400 ftp1.html
curl -s -m 60 "ftp://ftp.povray.org/pub/povray/" -o ftproot.txt; echo "RC=$?"; head -40 ftproot.txt
clear; curl -s -m 60 "ftp://ftp.povray.org/pub/povray/Old-Versions/" | head -30; echo ===OFFICIAL===; curl -s -m 60 "ftp://ftp.povray.org/pub/povray/Official/" | head -20
clear; curl -s -m 60 "ftp://ftp.povray.org/pub/povray/Old-Versions/Official-2.2/"

clear; DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -qq ncompress unzip 2>&1 | tail -2; mkdir -p /tmp/pov22; cd /tmp/pov22; for f in POVSRC.TAR.Z POVSRC.ZIP POVDOC.TAR.Z POVDOC.ZIP README2.2 WHATSNEW.DOC KNOWNBUGS.DOC; do curl -s -m 120 -O "ftp://ftp.povray.org/pub/povray/Old-Versions/Official-2.2/$f"; done; ls -la
WAIT 40
clear; cd /tmp/pov22; cat README2.2; echo ===; uncompress -t POVSRC.TAR.Z && echo SRC_Z_OK; uncompress -t POVDOC.TAR.Z && echo DOC_Z_OK; unzip -t POVSRC.ZIP | tail -2; unzip -t POVDOC.ZIP | tail -2
clear; cd /tmp/pov22; zcat POVSRC.TAR.Z | tar -tvf - | head -40; echo "TOTAL: $(zcat POVSRC.TAR.Z | tar -tf - | wc -l)"; echo ===DOC===; zcat POVDOC.TAR.Z | tar -tf - | head -30

clear; cd /tmp/pov22; zcat POVSRC.TAR.Z | tar -tvf - | grep -viE "^d" | awk '{print $NF}' | grep -iE "make|config|install|\.sh$|readme|\.doc$|\.txt$" ; echo ===ALLTOP===; zcat POVSRC.TAR.Z | tar -tf - | grep -vE "/.*" | head
clear; zcat POVSRC.TAR.Z | tar -tvf - | grep -E "machine/unix|machine/sun|machine/sgi" ; echo ===; zcat POVSRC.TAR.Z | tar -tf - | grep -cE "^source/"
clear; mkdir -p /app/povray-2.2; cd /app/povray-2.2; zcat /tmp/pov22/POVSRC.TAR.Z | tar -xf -; zcat /tmp/pov22/POVDOC.TAR.Z | tar -xf -; ls -la; echo ===; cat machine/unix/unix.doc
clear; ls /app/povray-2.2/; echo ===DOC-TOP===; head -60 machine/unix/unix.doc
clear; ls -la /app/povray-2.2/ | head -20; echo ===MAK===; cat machine/unix/unix.mak
clear; head -40 machine/unix/unix.mak; echo ===LSTOP===; ls /app/povray-2.2/
sed -n '40,75p' machine/unix/unix.mak; echo ===DIFF===; diff machine/unix/gccconf.h machine/unix/unixconf.h | head -40

clear; grep -n "^povray" machine/unix/unix.mak; sed -n "$(grep -n '^povray' machine/unix/unix.mak | head -1 | cut -d: -f1),+6p" machine/unix/unix.mak; echo ===UNIX.C===; grep -n "init" machine/unix/unix.c | head; grep -n "init" machine/unix/gcc.c | head
diff machine/unix/unix.c machine/unix/gcc.c

clear; which cc gcc; ls /etc/alternatives/cc 2>/dev/null; cd /app/povray-2.2 && mkdir -p build && cp source/* build/ && cp machine/unix/unix.mak build/makefile && cp machine/unix/unixconf.h build/config.h && ls build/ | head -30
cd /app/povray-2.2/build && make CFLAGS="-c -O -fcommon" 2>&1 | tail -40
cp machine/unix/unix.c build/ && cd build && make CFLAGS="-c -O -fcommon" 2>&1 | tail -15; ls -la povray 2>/dev/null
cp /app/povray-2.2/machine/unix/unix.c /app/povray-2.2/build/ && make CFLAGS="-c -O -fcommon" 2>&1 | tail -8; ls -la povray 2>/dev/null
install -m 755 /app/povray-2.2/build/povray /usr/local/bin/povray && /usr/local/bin/povray +L/app/povray-2.2/povdoc/include +I/app/deps/illum1.pov +O/dev/null +P -V
grep -niE "include|INCLUDE" /app/povray-2.2/build/config.h | head; echo ===; md5sum /app/deps/illum1.pov; stat -c "%y %s" /app/deps/illum1.pov

clear; grep -n "include" /app/povray-2.2/source/povray.c | grep -iE "path|dir|search" | head; grep -n "Search_for" /app/povray-2.2/source/*.c /app/povray-2.2/source/*.h | head; grep -n "POV_INCLUDE\|POVRAY_LIB\|povray.def\|/usr/povray\|/usr/lib/povray" -r /app/povray-2.2/source/ | head
grep -n "Locate_File" /app/povray-2.2/source/*.c /app/povray-2.2/source/*.h | head; echo ===; sed -n '/^FILE \*Locate_File/,/^}/p' /app/povray-2.2/source/povray.c | head -60

sed -n '95,165p' /app/povray-2.2/source/targa.c
